method: Visually reviewed actual rendered source crops at 36 px and 96–110 px on temporary contact sheets. No filename-only classification. Code mappings were checked for category/collision and direct-use context.
principle: Keep clear existing art. Simplify competing focal objects or miniature action scenes. Paired speech bubbles, hands, rings and tight face symbols may form one coherent subject. Exact brands use clean vector silhouettes.
coverageNotes: Native glyph entries enumerate literal Ionicons names; dynamic selectors use the same simple glyph provider.
Travel destination postcards and product illustrations are deliberate contextual previews, not action icons.
Character portraits, cinematic screens and playable mini-game scene layers are not action icons and remain outside this audit.
Generic camera/video/microphone artwork remains valid for content types; platform identity surfaces use dedicated real-brand marks.
IDs and mapping keys stay stable; this is artwork/presentation work, not save migration.
